verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I'm trading my sorrows
I'm trading my shame

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I'm laying them down
For the joy of the Lord

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I'm trading my sickness
I'm trading my pain

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
I'm laying them down
For the joy of the Lord

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
(We say) yes Lord, yes Lord
Yes yes Lord x2

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Yes Lord, yes Lord
Yes yes Lord, Amen

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
I am pressed but not crushed
Persecuted not abandoned

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
I am blessed beyond the curse
For His promise will endure

verse.name: b1d
verse.lines: That His joy's gonna be my strength

verse.name: b1e
verse.lines:
Though the sorrow
May last for the night
His joy comes in the morning

verse.lines:
Na na na na na na
Na na na na na

verse.name: o1a
verse.lines:
Jesus you light up my world like nobody else
The way that you show me love gets me overwhelmed

verse.name: o1b
verse.lines:
But when you shine all around it ain't hard to tell
We all know, oh oh, Jesus you're so beautiful

verse.name: o1c
verse.lines:
If only I can see what you see
I'll understand why you want me so desperately

verse.name: o1d
verse.lines:
Right now you're looking at me and I can't believe
We just know Jesus you're so beautiful
